subject.title: fix(tui): deduplicate assistant messages across sessions.changed reload

question: Should the TUI accept this PR’s finalized-versus-in-flight runId surrender policy for late chat events after `sessions.changed` new/reset reloads?
rationale: The patch is a plausible and well-tested bug fix, but it intentionally changes when late assistant deltas/finals are suppressed or rendered after a history reload, which can affect visible message delivery and session state.

options.title: Accept current surrender policy
options.body: Merge after normal required checks if maintainers agree that finalized surrendered runs should suppress all late finals and in-flight surrendered runs should render displayable finals only when needed.

options.title: Ask for additional proof
options.body: Pause for a maintainer-run TUI/Gateway or native Telegram-triggered recording if the shared Gateway/TUI terminal proof is not enough for this visible regression.

options.title: Revise the suppression contract
options.body: Keep the PR open for a narrower policy if owners want finalized runs to render late displayable finals when history replay did not visibly restore the row.

recommendation.title: Accept current surrender policy
recommendation.body: Merge after normal required checks if maintainers agree that finalized surrendered runs should suppress all late finals and in-flight surrendered runs should render displayable finals only when needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assigned reviewer on the live PR, so he is the best available owner for accepting or redirecting the merge-risk decision.
